description.from:
As an editor, I want public HN discoveries staged privately for review without requiring classifier integration or app credentials.

Current: manual collection succeeded at 2026-10-20T11:35:17Z with 30 private sources. Queue canonical dedup, independent discovery revisions, source timestamps/fingerprints, retry-safe checkpoints, failure retention, private JSON/Markdown and actual presentation receipts are implemented. No app auth or provider calls. Parent enabled hourly automation (America/New_York), but first scheduled execution/receipt is unverified. Remain in progress until recurrence is observed; do not substitute manual-run evidence.

Delivery: draft https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/382 . Collector code head 4a151214 passed all CI; combined guideline/tracker head bbacf15c passed Python, TypeScript and package-smoke CI. Collection is private staging, not full publication routing, Reference acceptance, publishing or learning.

Feature: Public collection preserves a private review queue.
Scenario: Resume collection without duplicates
Given a bounded public HN feed and private checkpoint
When a due collector repeats or observes a source revision
Then canonical sources are deduplicated and separate discovery provenance is retained
And already-presented sources remain recorded without inferred labels.
Scenario: Observe recurrence honestly
Given an enabled hourly scheduler
When its first scheduled collection runs
Then save an actual run/queue receipt before declaring recurring delivery verified.

Human decisions, rationale and editorial policy remain private outside Git. Received feedback is separate from applied feedback.
